name: browser-run-development-isolation
goal: A page under test in one browser run keeps its state when another run starts in the same checkout: a run starts no development server and serves the application under test, like its other servers, from its own checked copy of the finished build, so no other server's start reloads its pages, and a failed run names its first failing assertion

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: Record b141c19f of 1d5f793 (kept failed): test/reports-concurrent-runs.e2e.test.ts, second run, tests/e2e/harness-legacy.spec.ts:6 failed and 27 passed; the outer error kept only the end of the run's output, which leaves errors out when a JSON report is written. Until then the application under test of a run was a development server in the checkout; its other three servers already ran from the run's build copy. Root cause, demonstrated in a clean snapshot of 1d5f793 (work/stage-f/legacy-red/dev-pair-1.json): a development server writes every generated file again when it starts, because SvelteKit compares with what the process wrote and not with the disk, and every other development server of the checkout then sends full-reload to its pages (36 files written, 35 with unchanged content; the open page was loaded again and lost what was set on it). The committed spec under that event (work/stage-f/legacy-red/assertion-starts): harness-legacy.spec.ts:33 expect(image).toHaveJSProperty('complete', true) failed after 5 s, the evidence card image not found, the call log showing the page navigating. Sixteen repetitions of the committed check in the snapshot all passed (work/stage-f/legacy-red/loop): the start must land inside the few assertions after one click of one test.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test that faithfully reproduces the defect; record proof.
steps.evidence: work/logs/stage-f-run-pages-RED-final.log: clean snapshot of 1d5f793 outside every repository, verifier environment, committed suite configuration, only the final tests and test support laid over it: bun x vitest run test/reports-run-pages.e2e.test.ts exit 1, expected 0 loads of the first run's page after the second run started its servers, received 1. The same run with a stray .git in the snapshot is kept beside it and gave the same result.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: A browser run starts no development server: the application under test is served from the run's own checked copy of the finished build, as its other three servers are, started as harness report serve starts it (its address for form posts, the upload limit, the package as runtime root). Considered and dropped after trying them in a never-built export (work/stage-f/legacy-red/fresh-dev-1.json and -2.json): a SvelteKit output directory and dependency cache per run for a development server, because the package tsconfig extends ./.svelte-kit/tsconfig.json, so every transform failed without the default directory, SvelteKit warned on each start and a path through a symbolic link broke the generated imports; and switching the file watcher off, which only hides that the files are still written under a running server. Guard: test/reports-run-pages.e2e.test.ts, in test:package and in every verification; a failed run now names its failed tests and their first errors from its own report.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: packages/reports/playwright.config.ts: the second server entry seeds, builds outside a verification, copies the build and starts the application from the copy; the third starts the three other built servers; their time limits went from 240 s and 240 s to 420 s and 60 s because seeding and building now both precede the first server. test/support/browserRun.ts: the address of a run, its failures, runPassed, serving, repetition, and inner runs no longer inherit the caller's HARNESS_ANALYTICS_HOME and HARNESS_CONSOLE_E2E_HOME. New: test/support/runFailures.ts, test/reports-run-failures.test.ts, test/reports-run-pages.e2e.test.ts. package.json test:package, README and the feature specification. No registered unit changed: the impact analysis classes the configuration and package.json as global changes, so everything is rerun.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: work/logs/stage-f-run-pages-GREEN-snapshot.log: fresh clean snapshot of the candidate tree 5b5d7168 (fixture commit 105e86d0 in a scratch clone, outside every repository), verifier setup and environment, each check as the verifier runs it: reports-run-failures 3 passed, reports-run-pages 1 passed, reports-concurrent-runs 1 passed, reports-frozen-build 3 passed, whole browser suite 114 passed and 1 skipped; nothing written under packages/reports/.svelte-kit or node_modules/.vite, no run copy left.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: The red run is the proof: the same unchanged test against the committed configuration, where the application is a development server, fails with the page loaded once more; against the repaired configuration it passes. A trial in between (work/logs/stage-f-run-pages-green-trial-2.log) showed the guard also refuses a first run that ended before anything was observed, and prints that run's own failed tests.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and keep pending while proof fails.
steps.evidence: bun run check exit 0 on the working tree (work/logs/stage-f-check-6.log): 448 unit tests with 25 live-API tests skipped, 176 command-line end-to-end tests in 54 files, 31 package tests in 12 files with the 3 scale tests skipped, 118 reports unit tests in 54 files, audit and registry check passed. In the candidate snapshot the regression, the concurrency check, the frozen-build guard and the whole browser suite passed (work/logs/stage-f-run-pages-GREEN-snapshot.log). Fresh screenshots of the affected flow, the earlier reports with the evidence of one opened, were taken at 1440 and 390 pixels from a run's application server as it is now started and looked at: both reports with their recorded outcome, date and revision, the opened evidence and its capture (work/stage-f/legacy-red/screens). The complete verification was not repeated; it is Codex's to run.
